glance_takeaway: This page explains how diffusion models generate images: every image starts as pure random noise, and a trained network reverses a fixed ~1000-step noising process one small step at a time — the forward noising involves no learning, only the reverse denoiser is trained, and the output is a brand-new image (training images aren't stored or consulted). The main message is that nearly all diffusion variants (DDPM and successors) exist to make those ~1000 slow steps fewer or cheaper — there's a quality-vs-speed 'steps slider'.

F1.note: Section 1 diagram + standfirst: 'Forward — fixed noising, no learning' / 'Reverse — learned denoising, one small step at a time' starting from pure noise.

F2.note: 'T = 1000 steps · a predefined noise schedule'; caption: 'destroys a real image into pure Gaussian noise over about 1,000 steps'; t=1000 box labeled 'pure noise (TV static)'.

F3.note: Only the ε target appears ('a neural network predicts the added noise'); inputs (noisy image + timestep + prompt) never stated, and score/velocity parameterizations unnamed — caption 2's 'interconvertible training targets' is too oblique to teach this.

F4.note: Caption 1: 'trained only to undo one small step, by guessing the added noise under a simple mean-squared error' — though the random-timestep/closed-form noising and no-GAN contrast are omitted.

F5.note: Steps chart: 'DDPM (original) ~1000 · excellent quality · impractically slow'; standfirst: 'nearly every variant exists to make those steps fewer or cheaper'; sequential chaining implied by 'chaining those small steps backwards', not stated as non-parallelizable.

F6.note: 'DDIM 20–50 · deterministic · the everyday range'; caption 2: 'DDIM reuses the unchanged DDPM network with fewer, deterministic steps'.

F7.note: Inversion and interpolation enabled by DDIM's determinism are nowhere on the page.

F8.note: 'ODE solvers 10–20 · no retraining (DPM-Solver++)' conveys the practical claim; the SDE/probability-flow-ODE framing and DDIM-as-ODE-discretization are omitted.

F9.note: Section 3 pipeline: VAE encoder → 'denoising loop runs here' in latent space → VAE decoder 'one single pass'; caption: 'separately trained autoencoder'.

F10.note: Exact numbers on the diagram: '512×512×3, 786,432 numbers' → '64×64×4 = 16,384 · ≈48× fewer values'; caption: 'what put Stable-Diffusion-class models on consumer GPUs'.

F11.note: Formula 'guided = unconditional + s × (conditional − unconditional)' shown; caption 4: 'runs the network twice… doubles the true per-step cost; training randomly drops the prompt for ~10–20% of examples'.

F12.note: Number line: 's = 1 · no guidance', 's ≈ 7.5 common default', 's ≳ 12–15 · oversaturated colors, burned-in artifacts'; tradeoff labels low-s diversity vs high-s adherence.

F13.note: 'Distilled / consistency 1–4 · fastest · mild quality & diversity cost'; caption 2: 'retrained to take big jumps' — the any-point-to-endpoint consistency mapping is not explained.

F14.note: 'Rectified flow / flow matching ~20–30 · straight paths · SD3 / Flux'; caption 2: 'not competing technologies but one framework' — velocity-field prediction itself is not stated.

F15.note: Margin note: 'Generation starts here, from pure random noise — never from a photo (image-to-image is the explicit exception)'; caption 1: 'no training images are stored or consulted (rare near-duplication… exceptional failure mode, not the mechanism)'.

strengths: Quantitatively honest diagrams: the steps chart is a true log-scale axis with bars positioned exactly at their stated ranges (verified 20-50, 10-20, 1-4 against pixel coordinates), and the CFG number line places s=0/1/7.5/12-15 at correct linear positions
Very high fact density with precision — 13 of 15 ground-truth facts land, including exact latent-diffusion numbers (786,432 → 16,384, ≈48×) and the full CFG formula with drop rate and 2× cost
Caveats faithfully carried: memorization exception, img2img exception, VAE quality ceiling, quality/diversity cost of distillation, high-s artifact regime
weaknesses: Above-the-fold glance carries only the core mechanism (T1) — the steps-ladder chart, latent diffusion, and guidance (T2 details, T3, T4) all sit below the fold, capping glance comprehension

Training-side detail is thin: the three interconvertible parameterizations (ε/score/velocity), network inputs, closed-form one-shot noising, and the GAN contrast are absent (F3), as is DDIM invertibility/interpolation (F7)
Long captions do heavy lifting; several load-bearing facts (MSE objective, prompt-drop rate) live only in small muted caption text a skimmer may skip
